_README: Speculative outreach targets: employers worth a short note even when they have
no advert up. Curated for Harry - Aberdeen-first subsea/O&G, then Scottish
defence and comms employers known to hire ex-forces technicians. The 'note' is
the one concrete detail the email is allowed to use, so it stays factual.
Each company is emailed at most once ever, two per day across the list.
